name: Rafsanjan
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: 15 to 30+ (localized hotspots up to 37) across Rafsanjan Plain
literature_sources: Motagh, M. et al. (2008, 2017) & Haghighi & Motagh (2024), Sentinel-1/Envisat InSAR across Iran
Mousavi, S.M. et al. (2001), GPS land subsidence monitoring in Rafsanjan Plain
agreement_note: 120-day vertical estimate (-7.4 cm, ~22.5 cm/yr annualized) sits squarely inside the published 15-30+ cm/yr Rafsanjan Plain InSAR range. High spatial coherence (84.9% valid pixels), SNR=17.6, and external northern margin reference (56.236E, 30.646N) support reliable detection; ref_spread/peak=0.40 places confidence at medium.
press_summary_gate_note: Approved for press/atlas ranking as provisional 120-day estimate (84.9% valid pixels, consistent with 15-30+ cm/yr literature).

first_nisar_measurement.evidence: No peer-reviewed or official NASA/ISRO NISAR subsidence publication found for Rafsanjan as of 2026-11-14.

quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
